title: Easy Vehicle Physics
cue: drivable cars: suspension, gears, grip, drift, four presets
summary: Cars that drive like cars: ray-cast wheels with suspension, an engine with gears, tire grip by surface, steering and stability assists, and four tuned vehicles: arcade, simcade, drift, monster truck.
useWhen: The player or traffic drives cars that should accelerate through gears, lean, slide, and drift: a racing or driving game, an open world with roads, a stunt or delivery game. Tuning Godot's VehicleBody3D to this standard takes days.
avoidWhen: A kart or toy car on a small track is enough, which starter-kit-racing gives with its track pieces, or the vehicles only follow paths without physics.
